messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: HIGH — inference-api-eu — spike in 5xx and latency :rotating_light: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-9843

maria: I'm currently oncall and got the PD page, acknowledging now (ack'd via PD). jumping in to triage. :eyes:

tomas: saw an auto-ack from pagerduty->bot too, looks like two responders accepted. maria do you want primary? i can standby and take L2 if it flaps.

maria: taking primary. tomas standby please. i'll check error rates and hit the runbook.

lucy: Customer signal: Support flagged 4 customers in eu-west experiencing 5xx and token timeouts around 11:12-11:16 UTC. Request rates for those tenants up ~2x, but errors concentrated on /v1/generate.

maria: quick check: hitting metrics dashboard — 5xx rate from inference-api-eu rose to 12% at peak, p95 latency doubled. looks like a subset of dedicated pool nodes reporting OOM/worker restarts.

maria: running logs:```kubectl get pods -n inference-eu -l pool=dedicated-eu -o wide && kubectl logs pod/infer-87f -c runtime``` seeing repeated OOMKill on infer-87f and infer-9ac.

oncall-sre: if nodes are OOMing we should drain and replace, but short-term: suggest routing traffic away from the affected pool via the router weight override (route inference-api-eu -> reduce weight for dedicated-eu, bump shared-eu). i can apply if maria approves.

maria: yes please. oncall-sre go ahead with router weight change and trigger a scale up for shared-eu. i'll cordon affected nodes and collect core dumps.

oncall-sre: applying weight override:```curl -X POST https://router.internal/weights -d '{"service":"inference-api-eu","weights":{"dedicated-eu":0.3,"shared-eu":0.7}}'``` done — traffic shifting now.

pagerduty: Escalation scheduled if not resolved in 10m.

tomas: i pulled the node logs — GPU oom followed by runtime restart, looks like a bad quantized build on that pool. will open a ticket with build owner after we stabilise.

maria: initial customer impact summary for ops-cust: ~4 customers affected intermittently, errors peaked for 4 minutes, estimated ~120 failed requests total. informing support to create notifications.

lucy: notifying the customer ops channel now and adding suggested mitigation steps for users to retry. will coordinate follow-ups.

oncall-sre: shared-eu scaled by +3 warm nodes, healthchecks are green, 5xx rate dropping to ~1.5% and latency trending down.

maria: cordoned and drained two problematic nodes, collecting artifacts here: /opt/incident/INC-9843/artifacts. will preserve until postmortem.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded: maria (primary). tomas (backup). escalation locked.

maria: status ping — service stabilized, 5xx back to baseline, routing reverted to normal weights. will keep monitoring for 30m then close. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: monitoring set, alert thresholds temporarily raised for noise suppression.

lucy: support notified customers with summary, flagged for follow-up by SEs.

maria: marking this as mitigated. next steps: postmortem to include root cause (quantized build regression), cadence for dogfooding builds on dedicated pools, and an action to add per-pool OOM alerting. assigning postmortem owner: tomas.

tomas: got it, i'll own the postmortem. thanks all.

incidentbot: Incident INC-9843 marked mitigated by maria. Auto-close scheduled in 30m unless reopened.
